messages:
alice: Kicking off canary rollout for service=model-runtime -> version=release-2026-09-01-abc123. Starting at 10% traffic. Change window 30m. Monitoring dashboards: https://dash/redwood/runtime-rollouts/rs-abc123

deploy-bot: Rollout initiated
  id: rollout-1760004321
  service: model-runtime
  version: release-2026-09-01-abc123
  target: canary
  percent: 10
  started_by: alice
  note: automatic health checks enabled

carlos: quick ask — what are the abort criteria? p95 > 200ms or error-rate > 0.5%?

alice: Yep, those plus CPU > 85% on any host or new 5xx spike. If any of those hit, call STOP. @maya please watch infra metrics.

maya: watching now. will report every 5m. :eyes:

sasha: release notes are already pinned in the release thread: https://wiki/releases/v2.8.0

deploy-bot: Rollout update: rollout-1760004321 -> 25% (timestamp: 1760004350)

carlos: seeing p95 jump from 120ms -> 210ms on node pool-a, error-rate 0.12% -> 0.6% (small sample). tagging logs: https://logs/trace?query=rollout-1760004321

alice: that's above threshold. I'm calling STOP. Do not progress to 50%.

alice: STOP. :red_circle:

maya: confirmed. pausing. Taking snapshots of KV cache and clearing a couple of sticky slots.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by alice (user) — rollout-1760004321
  current_percent: 25
  status: paused

carlos: digging into logs, looks like a request-path regression in v=abc123 that hits a rarely-used route causing O(N^2) behavior. I can patch but it's non-trivial and will take ~2-3 hrs.

sasha: given the customer impact and change window, recommend rollback to release-2026-08-28-def456 and pin until patch is out.

alice: agree. decision: ROLLBACK + version pin. Notify CS if needed. Maya — open an incident for tracking.

maya: creating incident: INC-2026-4821 (prod -> model-runtime canary rollback). Notifying #incidents and oncall rotation.

alice: rollback command: `deployctl rollback --service model-runtime --to release-2026-08-28-def456 --reason "canary perf regression"`

carlos: I'll validate the patch in a dev cluster while rollback happens.

deploy-bot: Rollback started for rollout-1760004321 -> target_release=release-2026-08-28-def456
  initiated_by: alice
  timestamp: 1760004378

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. new active version: release-2026-08-28-def456
  status: success
  completed_at: 1760004390

alice: pinning release-2026-08-28-def456 for all traffic until we validate patch.

deploy-bot: Version pinned: release-2026-08-28-def456 (scope: global)

sasha: posting short postmortem + rollout notes to the release thread and will coordinate a canary re-run after hotfix.

maya: incident INC-2026-4821 created and linked to the rollback. Pager logs and customer-notify checklist started.

carlos: will open a PR for the fix, label it rollback-regression, and request expedited review.

alice: thanks everyone — nice call on STOP. Follow-up sync in 1h to review patch progress. :thumbsup:
